NeuraPath

STEM Career Recommender

Winner – National Swift Changemakers Hackathon 2025 (Bosch Challenge). Built an iOS vocational guidance app focused on promoting STEM careers through a gender-bias-free test, interactive flows, and a recommendation model using 16 personalities, multiple intelligences, and NLP.

Role
Product Designer & iOS Builder
Stack
SwiftUINLPMLFormsCareer Matching
Overview

NeuraPath helps students discover STEM career paths through a mobile experience that combines personality signals, learning preferences, and lightweight game interactions. The app was built during the National Swift Changemakers Hackathon 2025 for the Bosch Challenge.

Focus

The focus was product design and iOS execution: shaping the recommendation flow, designing fast and engaging interactions, and building the SwiftUI experience that connects assessment, career matching, and university enrollment actions.
